messages.text:
Hello HeliumDeploy team,

How would you feel about a performance-based partnership focused on converting site visitors who abandon their carts?

Our method involves phone calls and iMessage to guide qualified customers back to complete their purchase, and only take a percentage of the revenue we generate.

We don't charge any fees upfront, so our success is tied to HeliumDeploy recovering revenue.

I'd be happy to provide more information if you're interested.

Warmly,
Megan C. | Head of Partnerships at RevSave
Handed to the team · Business partnership proposal, not a customer order; only the team can decide on

Hello Megan,

Thanks for reaching out. Partnership proposals like this sit with our founders rather than with support, so I've passed your note to them directly.

They're offline at the moment and pick things up today at 10am Eastern. If it's a fit, one of them will reply to you here in this thread.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
